description_en: Updates the information of a specified live room by calling UpdateLiveRoom
description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveRoom更新指定直播相关信息
kebab_example: aliyun imp update-live-room --app-id 7m000q --title Title001 --notice Notice001 --cover-url http://000.png --extension AE350000T95F --anchor-id as0000hs --anchor-nick User001 --user-id user001 --live-id b7f20000ebb3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveRoom

parameters.description_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length

parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The live room title. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 32 characters.
parameters.description_zh: 直播标题，支持中英文，最大长度32位。
